description: Na₂Zn₂S₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.72-3.24 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form distorted NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with eight ZnS₄ tetrahedra, edges with three equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with four ZnS₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.84-2.96 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form distorted NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with six ZnS₄ tetrahedra, edges with five NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with six ZnS₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.86-2.96 Å. There are two inequivalent Zn sites. In the first Zn site, Zn is bonded to four S atoms to form ZnS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three NaS₆ octahedra, corners with five ZnS₄ tetrahedra, edges with three NaS₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ZnS₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-51°. There are a spread of Zn-S bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.39 Å. In the second Zn site, Zn is bonded to four S atoms to form ZnS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaS₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent ZnS₄ tetrahedra, edges with two NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with two ZnS₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-54°. There are a spread of Zn-S bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.43 Å. There are three inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four Na and three Zn atoms. In the second S site, S is bonded to three Na and three Zn atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SNa₃Zn₃ pentagonal pyramids. In the third S site, S is bonded to four Na and two Zn atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing SNa₄Zn₂ pentagonal pyramids.
